info.title: GovCon SCA FAR 52 222 41 Wage Determination Mapper API
info.description: Maps RFP Labor Categories (LCATs) and places of performance to U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA / FAR 52.222-41) Directory of Occupations codes and Davis-Bacon Act (DBA) wage determinations, auditing base hourly wage floors, Health & Welfare (H&W) fringe rates (Standard vs. EO 13706 Paid Sick Leave), FLSA exempt vs. non-exempt classifications, SF-1444 conformance requests, and FAR 52.222-43 Option-Year Price Adjustment tables.

rfp_labor_categories_and_locality_text.description: RFP labor categories, FTE counts, places of performance, Wage Determination (WD) numbers, and proposed base wages + H&W fringe.
rfp_labor_categories_and_locality_text.example: SOLICITATION: 47QTCK-26-R-0055 (Arlington, VA Locality, WD 2015-4281 Rev 28). LCATS: (1) Tier 1 IT Service Desk Specialist (12 FTEs, Proposed Base: $24.10/hr, H&W: $4.98/hr); (2) Tier 2 Network Technician (8 FTEs, Proposed Base: $31.50/hr); (3) Technical Writer (3 FTEs, Proposed Base: $33.25/hr); (4) Principal Cloud Architect (4 FTEs, FLSA Exempt $168,000/yr).

wage_determination_and_fringe_mode.description: Governing statutory wage regime (SCA FAR 52.222-41, CBA 4(c), or Davis-Bacon).
